llm.summary: The skill is a local, disclosed context-memory workflow, but users should understand it makes durable workspace and memory changes when applied.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently implement the stated purpose: installing a context_pipeline bundle, routing messages, retrieving local memory snippets, compressing context, validating fixtures, and checking memory freshness.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Activation and routing use broad natural-language phrases, so misrouting or accidental memory workflows are possible, but the behavior is visible and tied to the skill's stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The install path is explicit: copy bundled files into context_pipeline, patch AGENTS.md with a visible diff, validate, run a watchdog, and show git status. No hidden package install, network call, or obfuscated execution was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reading memory/always_on.md, topic files, now/open-loops, MEMORY.md, and limited daily logs is proportionate for a memory pipeline, though those files may contain private local context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill can persist files under context_pipeline, update AGENTS.md, write debug/audit artifacts, and commit memory notes; these are durable local changes, disclosed by the artifacts, and should be user-directed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want this workspace to use a persistent local memory/context pipeline. Review the AGENTS.md diff before accepting it, use explicit wording for apply or memorize actions, and avoid storing secrets or sensitive personal data in the memory files because later agent runs may retrieve and use that content.
llm.findings:
[VirusTotal] expected: Telemetry is clean with no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the verdict.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no findings, and manual inspection found local file-copy, validation, and test behavior rather than network, credential, or destructive behavior.
[LP3] expected: File reads and writes are real, including context_pipeline and AGENTS.md, but they are central to applying a workspace context pipeline and are documented in the skill instructions.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad apply, router, briefing, and memory trigger phrases are confirmed; they are not deceptive, but users should invoke apply/memorize workflows deliberately to avoid unintended routing or persistence.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent memory updates across daily logs, now/open-loops, topic files, and MEMORY.md are confirmed; this is purpose-aligned but should be treated as durable local storage.
